main_text.p: [illegible, ~6 letters][illegible, ~12 letters] Athenienses, pax in Laconas, [illegible, ~10 letters] annos & decem menses du-[illegible, ~8 letters]. Altera pars [illegible, ~14 letters] constat Thucyd. l. 1. annos. Postea Corinthiorum cum Argivis, Man-[illegible, ~20 letters] & [illegible, ~10 letters] Spartanis, ad Athenienses lylus, occurrunt. Tertium Laconum cum Boeotis, Atheniensium cum Argivis, Mantineis, & Eleis foedera ineunt. Quarta Argivorum in Epidaurios bellum obvertit, quod [illegible, ~8 letters] Atheniensibus, hiis, Spartanis supplet, ad octavum usque huius periodi annum, aemulantes Argivorum fortitudo, magnis Atheniensium & Spartanorum damnis, gestum est. Tertia Persarum ad ultimum Darii le extendit [illegible, ~10 letters] Coelen, Euboeorum Lesbio-rum, Chiorum & Erythraeorum defectionem, Thucyd. l. 8. Abydia Derrylida Spartano adempti * [illegible, ~6 letters]. Reges in Oligarchiam [illegible, ~12 letters] Thrasyllo & Thrasybulo ad Abydum de-[illegible, ~10 letters] Spartanis victoriam, occisum ad Cyzi-cum usque * Mindarum, repulsum aliquoties ab Atheniensibus, urbes in Thracia recuperans, ameri-tam Pylum, evocaverunt, quod Hermas deiectus [illegible, ~12 letters] Alcibiades, victorem marii Lysimachum & Callias Atticus, ab Lysandro tandem Imperatore aliud contra [illegible, ~8 letters] Atheniensis debellaturus exercitus [illegible, ~10 letters]. Hinc Athenae vincula, & fame coacti, ad [illegible, ~12 letters] quas decem tradere, &c. cuppa mortem.
In THRACIA praeter Odrysas, Aeolios, Dardanos Spartano [illegible, ~10 letters] Chios Lacedaemonii trium, quem excepit [illegible, ~6 letters] Spartaco. Xenoph. Hist.

page.notes: Scan is very dim, skewed and show-through from the reverse side is strong; most of the marginal notes on the left and the Greek-cited references on the right are illegible. The bottom paragraph and the right-margin references are partly unreadable and the readings are uncertain. The page number and running head are uncertain (possibly 237 and "Darii Motus"). Catchword and signature are not visible.
